chunks: День, когда сотрясающая (первый трубный звук) сотрясёт содрогаясь

key_terms.الرَّاجِفَةُ: Трясущая; первый великий землетрясение или удар Воскресения

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Rajifah' in the Quran?
ai.summary: В Shia exegesis, 'Al-Rajifah' is often identified as the first of the two major earthquakes preceding the Day of Resurrection, serving as a divine warning to humanity. This convulsive shaking is viewed not merely as a physical phenomenon but as a metaphysical upheaval that strips away worldly illusions, preparing souls for the final reckoning.
